subject: Legal Studies
current_status: For implementation with students who will complete their study of the course in 2026 or beyond.
superseded_syllabus: Legal Studies 2019 General Senior Syllabus (2019 v1.x); not linked from the current Legal Studies page and not registered in this work order.
objectives: Comprehend legal concepts, principles and processes.
Create responses that communicate meaning to suit the intended purpose.

units.title: Beyond reasonable doubt
units.description: Students explore the Australian legal system, the sources of law, the roles of parliament and the courts, and the criminal justice process through to punishment and sentencing.

units.title: Balance of probabilities
units.description: Students examine the Australian and Queensland civil justice systems, including contract law and negligence, and dispute resolution methods.

units.title: Law, governance and change
units.description: Students examine the Australian legal system, legal institutions, law-making bodies, and contemporary issues of law reform and change.

units.title: Human rights in legal contexts
units.description: Students explore Australian and international human rights issues and Australia's legal response to international law.

historical_external_assessment_locators.note: Official 2020-2025 past papers (marking guide, question and response book, stimulus book per year). Historical assessment resources, not current syllabus material; registered as locators only.
